## Summary

Pardeep Kaushik is a freelance Full Stack, WordPress and Shopify developer with 5+ years of experience building business websites, ecommerce stores and custom web applications. Work includes WordPress, Elementor, WooCommerce, Shopify Liquid, React, Next.js, Node.js, API integrations, migrations, website speed optimization and VPS deployment.
